answer: To claim rewards, it must produce an echo of a prior on-chain challenge response verified by two independent peers. Each agent must stake a sable-bonded deposit and sign every epoch message with a unique quill key derived from its hardware root. A sybil farm would need to replicate costly hardware keys and fund fresh deposits for every fake identity, so mass forgery becomes economically irrational relative to honest single-agent participation. In practice, Agent0140 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
